question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

This makes readers __contemplate __the motives people have for performing acts of charity.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"contemplate"** means to think deeply or carefully about something. (विचार करना)

 
 
• **Example: **She likes to **contemplate** the meaning of life during her morning walks.
 
 
 
• **"Overlook" **refers to fail to notice or consider something or someone. (नज़रअंदाज़ करना)
 
 
• **Example: **It is easy to **overlook **small details when you are in a hurry.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'contemplate' **is **'overlook'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Deviate **(विचलित होना): To depart from an established course or norm.

 
 
• **Example:** He tends to **deviate** from the main topic during discussions.
 
 
 
• **Follow up **(अनुसरण करना): To pursue or investigate something further.
 
 
• **Example: **The doctor asked her to **follow up** with him in a week.
 
 
 
• **Understate** (कम करके आंकना): To describe something as being smaller or less important than it actually is.
 
 
• **Example:** He tends to **understate** his achievements.
